g.text: 40000 synthetic events: true miss uniform within 3 km, hard-body radius 15 m, reported σ shrinking from km to tens of metres, covariance
realism error 30 %, correlated estimation errors, 15 % of CDMs missing. High risk: final Pc ≥ 10⁻⁵. Trees trained on half, tested on the
other half using CDMs up to 2 days before closest approach.
